§3Optional module. Half of the fuel cycle: it digs your uraninite up for you.§r
A 7x7 machine deck under a 20-block lattice tower with a drill string down the middle, standing out in FRONT of the silo on the right-hand side.

§5BILL§r
  §9144x§r Solid Steel Machine Casing
  §980x§r Steel Frame Box
  §919x§r Steel Pipe Casing
  §91x§r Output Bus §8(deck front wall, one course up)§r
  §8244 blocks.§r

§5WHAT IT PRODUCES§r
Every §9200 powered ticks§r (10 seconds):
  §26x Uraninite Dust + 1x Thorium Dust§r
  §2+1x Tantalum Dust§r on every 4th cycle
Draws §91,920 EU/t§r while it runs. That is the standalone Extraction Platform's rate, unchanged - this is the same machine, absorbed into the plant.

§cIT NEEDS POWER, AND THE REACTOR WILL NOT GIVE IT ANY§r
The word §9powered§r in that cycle count is literal. This is the §9first thing on the whole campus that CONSUMES EU§r, and it takes its 1,920 EU/t out of the §9output manifold's ENERGY HATCHES§r - the four §9E§r sockets one course above the dynamos, from step 9 - and out of nothing else. The reactor's own output does not reach it.
§6So do both of these before you expect a single dust:§r
  §91.§r Fit at least one §9Energy Hatch (IV)§r in that manifold face.
  §92.§r Run a live cable INTO it - your base grid, or straight off one of the Dynamo Hatches in the row below.
§cAn empty E socket, or a hatch with nothing wired to it, and the drill stands there for ever producing nothing.§r §8Steps 6 to 9 are right that no PIECE of this plant demands an Energy Hatch. This is the thing that does.§r

[warn]The panel names both failures. No hatch at all, in the OUTPUT group: §cManifold: NO Energy Hatch (y4, between the dynamos and the lasers) - the Extraction Derrick and the Enrichment Annex draw their EU through these, so neither will run§r. Hatch fitted but starved, the module line begins §cDerrick: UNDER-POWERED - it draws 1,920 EU/t and the manifold's Energy Hatches hold§r and then prints what they actually hold.[/warn]
§8While it says UNDER-POWERED the drill is drawing §9nothing at all§r§8 - it will not spend a partial tick. The trickle you are feeding it banks in the hatches until one whole tick is covered, so a grid too slow for 1,920 EU/t makes the drill SLOW, not dead.§r

[note]The product goes into the Derrick's OWN Output Bus. That bus belongs to this building and nothing else: no reactor demand can reach it, and a depleted fuel rod can never land in it.[/note]

[warn]An output bus that is FULL - or one you have ITEM-LOCKED to something else - stalls the drill holding a finished load. It says so by name on the panel. Empty it, or clear the lock.[/warn]

[note]Site: §9a 33-39, c 4-10§r, ground to 19 up.[/note]
